name: Fairness Benchmark for AI-Generated Face Detection
description: The task involves detecting AI-generated faces while ensuring fairness across demographic groups, using the AI-Face dataset which includes real and AI-generated faces annotated with demographic attributes such as skin tone, gender, and age.

cr:input.name: AI-Face Dataset
cr:input.description: A dataset containing 400,885 real face images and 1,245,660 AI-generated face images. The fake images are generated using Deepfake Videos, GANs, and Diffusion Models, and all images are annotated with demographic attributes: skin tone (Monk Skin Tone Scale), gender (binary), and age (five groups).
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset format, e.g., image/jpeg]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions indicating whether a face is real or AI-generated, along with fairness metrics across demographic groups.

field.name: is_ai_generated
field.description: Indicates whether the face is AI-generated (true) or real (false). Example: true.

field.name: demographic_group
field.description: The demographic group of the face based on skin tone, gender, and age. Example: 'Skin Tone 5, Female, Adult'.

field.name: fairness_score
field.description: Fairness score of the detection model for the specific demographic group. Example: 0.85.

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: [FILL IN THE BLANK: primary evaluation metric]
metrics: [FILL IN THE BLANK: list of all metrics mentioned in the paper]
cr:evaluation.higherIsBetter: [FILL IN THE BLANK: true or false]
cr:evaluation.notes: [FILL IN THE BLANK: any special computation details for the metrics]
